label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (XSS): alert-TP - User input from request header flows through doSomething() where bar = param (ternary condition (7*42)-106=188 is not > 200, so param assigned). Bar reaches LDAP filter at line 65 which is then logged/output at lines 90-91. Although encodeForHTML() is called at the sink, the primary vulnerability is LDAP injection at line 65 where bar is unsanitized in the filter string. Alert 2 (LDAP-injection): alert-TP - Same data flow: getHeader -> param -> decode -> doSomething -> bar -> filter at line 65. The filter "(&(objectclass=person))(|(uid=" + bar + ")(street={0}))" allows LDAP injection attacks. Both alerts are TP due to unsanitized user input reaching sensitive operations.
